heading: Today
text: Areas of dense valley fog burning off by mid-morning.  Sunshine, mixing with increasing afternoon clouds in NY, and south of I-89.  Warmer.  Highs in the low to mid 70s.  Light winds, becoming south up to 10 mph, increasing to 10 to 15, gusting to 30 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds, with showers arriving in the Hudson Valley near midnight, becoming likely from the Champlain Valley east overnight.  Milder.  Lows in the 50s to near 60.  Winds south up to 10 mph east, and 10 to 15, gusting 20 to 30 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Sunday
text: Morning showers through NH, and from St. Johnsbury, Rutland, and Lake George south ending. Periods of clouds, limited sun, with scattered afternoon showers or a thunderstorm in the Adirondacks, spreading east to the Green Mountains late.  Highs in the 70s.  Winds south, shifting to the southwest near 10 mph east, and 10 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains west.
